df_native = pd.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "spend": [500, 1500, 999, 1000, 2000]
})

```python
import pandas as pd
import narwhals as nw

df_native = pd.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "spend": [500, 1500, 999, 1000, 2000]
})

df = nw.from_native(df_native)

df_with_tier = df.with_columns(
    nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)
    .then(nw.lit("gold"))
    .otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
    .alias("tier")
)

print(df_with_tier.to_native())
```
